brief_answer: To monitor water in a petroleum stream with an analyzer located outside the process area, mid-infrared ATR spectroscopy is the primary method to test first, supported by literature precedents. Key details such as the required detection limits, process conditions, and exact fiber run distance must be clarified. A first feasibility experiment should test representative samples against independent laboratory reference measurements.
